Password Policy (IT-POL-007, rev. 4)

Passwords for corporate accounts are rotated every 90 days. Passwords must be at least 14 characters and may not reuse any of the last 12 values.
Service account passwords are stored in the approved vault and rotated by the IAM team.
Users who forget their password use the self-service reset portal. Helpdesk staff verify identity before issuing a temporary password, which expires at first login.
